memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: New onset radiating left leg pain, positive straight leg raise, weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (male cut-off 90 cm).
  - Plan: Start pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advise avoid heavy lifting, apply heat. Order straight leg raise test, MRI lumbar spine and X-ray lumbar spine. Review in 8 weeks.
- Weight: 68 kg
- Waist: 78 cm (within normal for male)
- Due: HbA1c - 2025-07-05

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: Left leg pain reproduced at 45° elevation, right leg negative. Suggestive of L5-S1 radiculopathy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: Mild disc bulge at L4-L5 with no cord compression. No significant stenosis.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: X-ray lumbar spine: Anterior osteophytes at L3-L4, L4-L5. Disc space preserved. No acute fracture.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Pain in left leg worse after long drives, tingling in foot. Took pregabalin as prescribed, mild drowsiness. Diclofenac helped a bit but stomach discomfort after meals.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: Improved leg pain, occasional tingling, weight 67 kg, waist 76 cm. Reports mild gastric upset with diclofenac.
  - Plan: Continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, stop diclofenac, start paracetamol 500 mg QID after food for breakthrough pain. Continue methylcobalamin. Advise physiotherapy for core strengthening. Review in 3 months.
- Weight: 67 kg
- Waist: 76 cm
- Due: HbA1c - 2025-10-01
